set system host-name PE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols cfm version standard.explanation: 配置CFM协议的版本为标准版本。

parameters.name: version
parameters.explanation: CFM协议的版本，此处为标准版本。

set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.template: set protocols cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] continuity-check interval [parameter3]
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.command: set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1 continuity-check interval 3
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.explanation: 配置CFM域中服务的连续性检查间隔时间。

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查的间隔时间，单位为秒。

set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.template: set protocols cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] continuity-check mep [parameter3] interface [parameter4] [parameter5]
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.command: set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1 continuity-check mep 1 interface ge-1/0/1.1 inward
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.explanation: 配置CFM域中服务的MEP（维护端点）的接口和方向。

set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.template: set protocols cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] continuity-check mep [parameter3] remote-mep [parameter4] peer-ip [parameter5]
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.command: set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1 continuity-check mep 1 remote-mep 2 peer-ip 1.1.1.1
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.explanation: 配置CFM域中服务的MEP的远程MEP和对端IP地址。

set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.template: set protocols cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] continuity-check mep [parameter3] remote-mep [parameter4] continuity-check-receive
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.command: set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1 continuity-check mep 1 remote-mep 2 continuity-check-receive
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.explanation: 配置CFM域中服务的MEP接收远程MEP的连续性检查。

set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.template: set protocols cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] continuity-check mep [parameter3] loss-measurement dual-ended test-id [parameter4]
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.command: set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1 continuity-check mep 1 loss-measurement dual-ended test-id 1
set protocols cfm domain md1 service ma1.explanation: 配置CFM域中服务的MEP的双端丢失测量测试ID。

set protocols mpls interface ge-1/0/2.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols mpls ldp router-id 2.2.2.2.explanation: Configures the Router ID of the LDP protocol.

set protocols ospf area 0.explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface ge-1/0/2.0.explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.

set protocols l2circuit neighbor 1.1.1.1.explanation: Configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) neighbor with the specified IP address (`[parameter1]`) for point-to-point pseudowire connectivity.

interface ge-1/0/1.1.explanation: This command configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) by specifying a neighbor device (`parameter1`) and associating it with a local interface (`parameter2`) for pseudowire establishment.

virtual-circuit-id ldp1.explanation: The L2 circuit is equipped with neighbours, interfaces and virtual circuit ID.
